      (deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (t, y₀)) x) x)
  (hanalytic : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g →
    (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (deriv g x) x) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => deriv g x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, C ≤ x → |g (x + 1) - g x| ≤ 1) :
  ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ y : Y, F (x, y) = f x) ∧
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, C ≤ x → ∀ y : Y,
      |F (x + 1, y) - F (x, y)| ≤ 1) := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => F (x, y₀)
  have hf_cont : Continuous f := by
    dsimp [f]
    exact hF.comp (by
      fun_prop)
  have hf_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt f (deriv f x) x := by
    intro x
    simpa [f] using hslice_deriv x
  have hf_limit :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => deriv f x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa [f] using hslice_limit
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hanalytic f hf_cont hf_deriv hf_limit
  have hEq : ∀ x : ℝ, ∀ y : Y, F (x, y) = f x := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [f]
    exact hfiber (x, y) (x, y₀) rfl
  refine ⟨f, hf_cont, hEq, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y
  rw [hEq (x + 1) y, hEq x y]
  exact hC x hx
